post.summary: Generate a ranked playlist from supplied tracks and audio measurements
post.description: Validates a version-1 dataset of 1–500 tracks, mandatory requirements and fuzzy preferences. Filters requirements before ranking, so rejected tracks cannot return through preference matching. Numeric scores are sorted descending, null scores last, and ties retain source order. No Spotify session or external API calls are required. Does not read a file or create a Spotify playlist. Additional input properties are ignored.

requestBody.description: JSON body up to 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes). All three sections are required; explicit null disables an individual requirement or preference.

200.description: Ranked accepted tracks with per-feature explanations and rejected tracks with all reasons. An empty ranking, including when every track is rejected, is a successful result.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR for missing body or sections, invalid metadata, duplicate identifiers, measurements or criteria; INVALID_JSON for malformed JSON.

AudioMeasurementCounts.description: Number of available measurements used as the denominator for each percentage. Missing measurements and failed track reads are excluded.

mode.description: Tracks with a recognized major or minor mode.

liveness.description: Tracks with an available liveness measurement.

instrumentalness.description: Tracks with an available instrumentalness measurement.

speechiness.description: Tracks with an available speechiness measurement.

AudioStats.description: Audio statistics calculated from available measurements. Percentages use their own per-feature denominator: null means no measurements, while zero means measurements exist but none match the category.

majorPercentage.description: Percentage of major-mode tracks among recognized modes; null when there are no mode measurements.

minorPercentage.description: Percentage of minor-mode tracks among recognized modes; null when there are no mode measurements.

liveTrackPercentage.description: Percentage of available liveness measurements greater than 0.8; null when there are none.

instrumentalTrackPercentage.description: Percentage of available instrumentalness measurements greater than 0.5; null when there are none.

speechHeavyTrackPercentage.description: Percentage of available speechiness measurements greater than 0.66; null when there are none.

details.description: Optional public error details, when provided.

PlaylistUnitMeasurement.description: A measurement from 0 to 1, or null for unavailable data. Zero is a valid measurement.

PlaylistAudioFeatures.description: All eight fields are required, including when a measurement is unavailable. Extra fields are discarded.

tempo.description: Positive tempo in BPM, or null for unavailable data.

PlaylistTrack.description: Source-independent track metadata and measurements. Text fields are trimmed; extra fields are discarded.

id.description: Unique within the dataset after trimming. Does not have to be a Spotify ID.

PlaylistDataset.description: Version-1 dataset; track IDs must be unique after trimming. Extra fields are discarded.

PlaylistTempoRange.description: Inclusive positive BPM bounds. Min must not exceed max; equal and fractional bounds are accepted. Extra fields are discarded.

PlaylistRequirements.description: All fields are required. Null disables a condition; zero remains an active maximum. Every active requirement must be met, and a missing required measurement rejects the track. Extra fields are discarded.

PlaylistPreferenceSetting.description: Exact case-sensitive preference level, or explicit null for no preference. Values are not trimmed or coerced.

PlaylistPreferences.description: All five fields are required. Preferences affect ranking but never reject tracks. Extra fields are discarded.

PlaylistFeatureMatch.description: One active preference. When measurement is null, match is also null. Disabled preferences produce no entry. Low has full membership up to 0.25 and falls to zero at 0.5; medium rises from zero at 0.25 to one at 0.5 and falls to zero at 0.75; high rises from zero at 0.5 to one at 0.75 and stays at one. These thresholds are project parameters, not universal music definitions.

overallMatch.description: Unrounded mean of available matches, with equal weights. Zero counts in the mean; null matches do not. Null means no active preferences or no available matching measurements. Not a probability of liking the track.

featureMatches.description: All active preferences, including missing measurements. Empty when all preferences are disabled. The number of non-null matches relative to this array's length describes completeness; no completeness penalty is applied.

PlaylistTrackRejectionReason.description: Reason for failing an active requirement. All reasons for a rejected track are returned.

GeneratedPlaylist.description: Every supplied track appears in exactly one group. Empty groups are valid. Text metadata is normalized; extra input properties are not returned.

rankedTracks.description: Accepted tracks sorted by descending score; null last, stable source order for ties. No active preferences means source order.

rejectedTracks.description: Rejected tracks and their reasons, retaining source order.

genre.description: First Last.fm top tag; it is not an authoritative genre

genreIsFallback.description: True when tags come from the artist instead of the track
